description: lockFileMaintenance is how transitive dependencies get updated at all. It has no release timestamp, so Renovate's minimumReleaseAge would keep it pending forever and is "0 days" there; pnpm applies the one in pnpm-workspace.yaml when it regenerates the lockfile.
lockFileMaintenance has its own default schedule, so it repeats the weekly one.

customManagers.description: Keep the SHA-pinned `uses:` examples in index.html current, the same way buildcage/docker tracks the ones in its Markdown docs. The examples are syntax-highlighted, so `(?:</?[a-z][^>]*>|\s)*` lets tags and whitespace sit between the tokens; it still matches the plain-text form too.

packageRules.description: Buildcage's own actions are exempt from minimumReleaseAge and from the weekly schedule, so the landing page can show a new release immediately.
Remotion packages share one version and one lockfile entry, so separate PRs for each merge into duplicate keys.
